jobs.title: Deputy Communications Manager – Editorial and Digital Content Lead, UK PACT
jobs.reason: Moritz has a strong academic background in international relations, policy research, and European foreign policy, aligning well with the likely focus of UK PACT. Their research, policy writing, digital skills (including journalism workshop experience and various software), and multilingualism are highly relevant for an editorial and digital content role. However, the "Deputy Communications Manager" title suggests a level of professional experience and management responsibility that the candidate, with only student assistant roles, does not yet possess.

jobs.title: Assistant Digital Producer (Term‑Limited)
jobs.reason: While the core function of digital content stewardship and metadata management is not a direct match to the candidate's primary research interests, the role is within a prominent research organization focused on international affairs and policy, aligning with the candidate's academic background. The candidate possesses strong research, data analysis (Python), policy writing, and multilingual skills, along with relevant digital aptitude. The experience level (1-3 years or equivalent) is a good fit for their extensive student assistant experience.

jobs.title: FSSC Auditor Canada
jobs.reason: This role is a very poor match. The job requires highly specialized experience in food safety auditing, management systems (FSSC22000, ISO9001), and a background in food science, microbiology, or chemistry. The candidate's academic and professional background is entirely in international relations, law, and social sciences, with no relevant industry experience or certifications. The seniority requirement of 3+ years full-time experience in the food industry also makes this role unsuitable.

jobs.title: Associate Lecturer (Teaching) in Quantitative Methods
jobs.reason: This role is a poor fit primarily due to the seniority requirement, which explicitly states candidates should have completed a PhD or be close to completion. The candidate, while academically strong with an MSc in progress, does not meet this fundamental criterion. Additionally, while the candidate has data analysis skills and proficiency in SPSS/Python, they lack explicit teaching experience in quantitative methods, and their stated interests lean towards qualitative research.

jobs.title: Intelligence Analyst - LATAM
jobs.reason: The candidate has a strong academic background in International Relations and Security Studies, with excellent research and analytical skills that align well with the role's demands. Their student assistant experience also meets the minimum work experience requirement. However, the critical gap in Spanish language proficiency, a stated requirement for this LATAM-focused role, significantly hinders their suitability.

jobs.title: Technical Manager - Nuclear Projects
jobs.reason: This role is a highly specialized and senior position in nuclear projects, requiring extensive technical expertise in nuclear engineering, conformity assessments, and specific industry codes, along with significant line management experience. The candidate's background is in international relations, law, and social sciences, with academic research and administrative assistant experience. There is a fundamental mismatch in both the technical field and the required seniority and management experience.

jobs.title: Paralegal
jobs.reason: The candidate's strong academic background in International Law and excellent research, writing, and administrative skills align well with the legal research, compliance, and regulatory aspects of the role. While the job seeks an "experienced Paralegal" and the candidate lacks direct commercial paralegal experience, their extensive student assistant roles provide valuable transferable skills. The seniority requirement is a stretch, but the strong foundational skills and academic relevance make it a plausible fit.

jobs.title: Advisory Lead - APAC
jobs.reason: This role is a very poor match for the candidate. The candidate's background is academic, focused on international relations and policy research, with only student assistant experience. There is no alignment in field, required commercial skills, or experience level.
